numerical.coordinate_set: fixed on the development units (reference of a declared class in every one)

rules.interpretation: the residual has the opposite sign of the reference: magnitudes pulled toward zero
rules.question: reference_alignment

rules.interpretation: the residual is anti-aligned with the reference: the output is scaled down

fixed_direction_mean
rules.rule_definition: w = normalized mean of the development midpoints (saved)

vector_mean.question: fixed-direction mean: E[e] != 0 at the measurement point

tests.note: one-sided, box-conservative sign-flip; exact sign-flip test when the null unit distribution is symmetric and the boxes have zero width; the flips are the first draws of numpy default_rng(seed) (choice of -1 / +1, shape (flips, units))

alignment.question: reference-dependent alignment: e correlates with the reference (scaling / shrinkage)

limits: rare values that do not appear among the units cannot be diagnosed from the data
t-type tests assume an approximately normal mean projection; the diagnostics flag concentrated, skewed or heavy-tailed scores but cannot exclude unseen rare values
NOT_CONFIRMED is not evidence of a zero mean; see the calibrated detection rates

equivalence_scale.meaning: delta = delta_rel * q_R per coordinate; on a projection, times sqrt(n)
